acip_transport_t * acip_async_tcp_accepted_create (platform_event_stream_t * stream)

Queue complete packets from an accepted stream on its listener's loop. The returned transport is owned by the accepting caller. Destroy it outside the loop thread while the listener is running, or after the listener stops.

acip_transport_t * acip_async_tcp_client_create
  (socket_t * socket, crypto_context_t * crypto)


Native client adapter. Owns a loop thread; recv waits on a bounded
    packet queue. Takes socket ownership when *socket becomes
    INVALID_SOCKET_VALUE.

acip_transport_t * acip_async_tcp_transport_create
  (platform_event_stream_t * stream, crypto_context_t *
  crypto)


Outbound ACIP adapter. Incoming packets are delivered by the
    connection's decoder. Destroy after the stream close callback, when workers
    have drained.
